phases.label: Levels 1-3
goals: Get through the first levels without losing much HP or CS.
Win or at least match the level 2 race (first wave plus three melee minions of the second).
do: Trade when your opponent walks up to last-hit a minion.
Watch where the enemy jungler started; the first gank can come around 2:45-3:30.
dont: Don't trade into a bigger minion wave: minions hit hard at levels 1-3.
Don't push up to their tower without knowing where their jungler is.
ifAhead: Zone them off the wave and crash it into their tower for plates.
ifEven: Farm, trade only on their cooldowns, keep the wave near the middle or your side.
ifBehind: Let the wave come to you and farm near your tower. Don't contest CS in melee range.

phases.label: Levels 4-5
goals: Keep the CS lead or close the gap.
Save gold for your first real component.
do: Use the jungler's shown position (kill feed) to decide when to push.
Recall on a crashed wave with enough gold for a component.
dont: Don't chase kills past the river without vision.
ifAhead: Crash waves for plates, ward the river before you push.
ifEven: Short trades when their main ability is down.
ifBehind: Freeze near your tower if you can; wait for level 6 and your first item.

phases.label: Level 6 -> first item
goals: Use level 6 power windows when the opponent doesn't have theirs.
do: Track the enemy's ultimate: many top laners win the fight with it.
Push before dragon and grubs so you can move first.
dont: Don't fight a level 6 opponent without your own ultimate.
ifAhead: Look for dives with your jungler and take plates.
ifEven: Farm to your item; fight only on clear windows.
ifBehind: Stay safe: farm under tower, don't give more gold.

phases.label: First item -> 14:00
goals: Turn your first item into plates, grubs or Herald.
Keep Teleport ready for fights on the map.
do: Push, then help your jungler at objectives.
Recall when a second component is affordable.
dont: Don't split deep without vision while their jungler is unseen.
ifAhead: Pressure the turret and pull the enemy jungler to your side.
ifEven: Match your opponent's movements; don't lose the wave.
ifBehind: Farm safely and join your team's fights with Teleport instead of losing more in lane.

phases.label: Mid game
goals: Be where the next objective is, or pressure the opposite side lane.
do: Push the side lane opposite the next objective, then join or Teleport.
Group for dragon and Baron when your team calls it.
dont: Don't farm the side lane while four enemies start an objective.
ifAhead: Take side-lane towers and force the enemy to answer you.
ifEven: Farm safe side waves and group for objectives.
ifBehind: Stay with your team and farm lanes on your side of the map.

phases.label: Late game
goals: One fight decides the game: don't get caught before it.
do: Arrive at objectives first and together.
Know your job in the fight (frontline, flank or peel) before it starts.
dont: Don't split without vision or Teleport while Baron or Elder is up.
Death timers are long: a pick can lose the game.
ifAhead: Siege with your team; take Baron after a won fight.
ifEven: Wait for their mistake; keep vision around the next objective.
ifBehind: Defend with your team, clear waves, look for a pick near your side.

trading: Trade when your opponent uses their main ability or walks up for a last hit.
Trade with your minion wave, not into theirs.
Walk out of a trade before their cooldowns are back.
waveManagement: Crash the wave before you recall so you lose no CS.
Push before objectives so you can move first.
When behind, let the wave push to you and farm near your tower.

when: You win the 1v1 against whoever comes to stop you.
Your team can hold the middle without you.
rules: Push the lane opposite the next objective.
Leave when two enemies are missing from the map.
tpUsage: Keep Teleport for fights at objectives when you split.

teamfight.role: Depends on your champion: frontline, flanker or peel.
rules: Don't go first into full crowd control unless you're the engage.
Stay with your team before objectives.
targetPriority: The closest threat you can reach safely, then their carries.

objectives: Dragon at 5:00, Voidgrubs at 8:00, Rift Herald at 15:00, Baron at 20:00.
Push your wave before every objective so you arrive first.
commonMistakes: Fighting before your first item against a strong early opponent.
Split pushing without vision while the enemy starts Baron or Soul.

enemy_laner_dead: Shove the wave into their turret and take plates, or recall with the gold you have.
you_died_to_gank: Ward the river before you push next time, and check where their jungler last showed.
you_died_solo: Don't fight them again until you have an item or level advantage; farm safely.
opp_level_lead: Don't fight until you catch up in levels.
you_level_lead: Short power window: trade now if their cooldowns are down.
you_hit_level_2_first: Trade right away before they hit level 2 as well.
you_hit_6: Look for a fight if your opponent isn't level 6 yet.
first_item_done: Your first spike: pressure the lane or objectives.
second_item_done: Two items: look for fights and objectives.
three_items_done: Full spike: force objectives with your team.
you_are_fed: Take towers and objectives; don't throw the lead with risky deaths.
you_are_behind: Farm safely and scale; don't take even fights.
enemy_laner_fed: Don't 1v1 them; play with your team.
enemy_team_numbers_down: Take the biggest objective that fits before they respawn.
baron_up_soon: Push your wave now so you can be at Baron in time.
dragon_up_soon: Push your wave now so you can move or Teleport to dragon.
grubs_soon: Push your wave and help with the grubs.
herald_soon: Push your wave and help with Herald.
enemy_jungler_ganked_top_repeatedly: Ward the river and play near your tower until your jungler can cover you.
long_death_timers: A death now can lose the game: don't get caught alone.
turret_lost: Play near your next turret and watch for dives.
enemy_turret_taken: Move to the next objective or rotate.
